interface.shortDescription: Research insight to editable, auditable PPT
interface.longDescription: Turn evidence-backed academic and industry research into technically accurate leadership presentations with full slide storyboards, source-faithful charts, editable PowerPoint diagrams, explanation-first per-source speaker notes, zero-drift revisions, and rigorous PPTX/PDF/PNG QA.
interface.defaultPrompt: Turn this evidence-backed research into a technical leadership PPT. First verify claim-to-source handoff and full page-by-page content/story contracts. Then produce native editable slides with cited data charts, explain-slide-first Notes plus source-by-source proof, and strict Minimal Change & Content Fidelity checks. Deliver PPTX/PDF/full preview and QA.
